python -c "
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/data.sqlite')
q1 = '''SELECT (r.amount / o.amount) * 100 AS yield
FROM revenues r
JOIN operating_metrics o ON r.period_end = o.period_end AND r.months = o.months
WHERE r.period_end = '2024-12-31' AND r.months = 12
AND r.category = 'Transaction revenues'
AND o.metric = 'Total payment volume';'''
print(conn.execute(q1).fetchone())

q2 = '''SELECT (r.amount / o.amount) * 100 AS yield
FROM revenues r
JOIN operating_metrics o ON r.period_end = o.period_end AND r.months = o.months
WHERE r.period_end = '2023-12-31' AND r.months = 12
AND r.category = 'Transaction revenues'
AND o.metric = 'Total payment volume';'''
print(conn.execute(q2).fetchone())

q3 = '''SELECT (
  (SELECT r.amount / o.amount FROM revenues r JOIN operating_metrics o ON r.period_end = o.period_end AND r.months = o.months WHERE r.period_end = '2024-12-31' AND r.months = 12 AND r.category = 'Transaction revenues' AND o.metric = 'Total payment volume') -
  (SELECT r.amount / o.amount FROM revenues r JOIN operating_metrics o ON r.period_end = o.period_end AND r.months = o.months WHERE r.period_end = '2023-12-31' AND r.months = 12 AND r.category = 'Transaction revenues' AND o.metric = 'Total payment volume')
) * 10000 AS yield_change_bps;'''
print(conn.execute(q3).fetchone())

q4 = '''SELECT (
  (SELECT amount FROM revenues WHERE period_end = '2024-12-31' AND months = 12 AND category = 'Transaction revenues') -
  (SELECT amount FROM revenues WHERE period_end = '2023-12-31' AND months = 12 AND category = 'Transaction revenues')
) / (
  (SELECT amount FROM revenues WHERE period_end = '2024-12-31' AND months = 12 AND category LIKE 'Total net revenues%') -
  (SELECT amount FROM revenues WHERE period_end = '2023-12-31' AND months = 12 AND category LIKE 'Total net revenues%')
) * 100 AS tx_contribution;'''
print(conn.execute(q4).fetchone())
"
